#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

long long modpow(long long b, long long e) {
    long long res = 1;
    b %= MOD;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) res = (res * b) % MOD;
        b = (b * b) % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    cout.tie(NULL);

    int n;
    long long k;
    cin >> n >> k;

    if (k > n - 1) {
        cout << 0 << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    vector<long long> fac(n + 1);
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * (i % MOD)) % MOD;
    }

    auto ncr = [&](int n, int r) -> long long {
        if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
        long long num = fac[n];
        long long den = (fac[n - r] * fac[r]) % MOD;
        return num * modpow(den, MOD - 2) % MOD;
    };

    int pop = n - (int)k;
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= pop; ++i) {
        long long term = (ncr(pop, i) * modpow(pop - i, n)) % MOD;
        if (i & 1) term = (MOD - term) % MOD; // multiply by -1
        ans = (ans + term) % MOD;
    }
    ans = ans * ncr(n, pop) % MOD;
    if (k != 0) ans = ans * 2 % MOD;
    cout << ans << '\n';

    return 0;
}
